items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His kids were great fun. I used to spend time with them over at his house.

ctx.x: Very. His kids were great fun. I used to spend time with them over at his house. He had a beautiful Japanese-style house, with a rock that was on the property in the middle of his living room. The architect built it around the house that way. He kept it, I guess, waterproof and mice- and other rodents-proof, somehow. It was great to see this natural rock sitting there.
